key_impacts: Orthopaedic and trauma services at Nalut Hospital required support during the conflict.
Previously inaccessible areas in the Nafusa Mountains limited access for operations.
evidence_snippets: Emergency response in the Nafusa mountains in response to the civil crisis that erupted in February 2011.
Supported orthopaedic and trauma services in Nalut Hospital during the height of the conflict.
Able to expand to previously inaccessible areas in the Nafusa Mountains after late August.
